evidence: Implements an in-tree test runner in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and updates unit test utilities.
rationale: Replacing Boost.Test with an in-tree framework addresses long-standing technical debt and significantly improves test diagnostics through expression decomposition. Reviewer support notes that an in-house customizable framework 'removes barriers to writing tests and enables concurrency improvements to speed up CI', delivering substantial architectural value to unit test infrastructure.
